key_insight: Infinity-Wasserstein robust PCA admits an exact finite-dimensional reformulation while retaining samplewise residual information that can reshape the principal subspace.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a principled way to make dimensionality reduction more resilient to distributional uncertainty rather than simply recovering nominal PCA.
method: Derive an exact reformulation and an explicit worst-case distribution.
Establish a uniform finite-sample guarantee assuming a finite fourth moment.
Solve the nonconvex, nonsmooth problem using iteratively reweighted majorization-minimization with convergence analysis.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments support computational efficiency and downstream effectiveness, but the abstract provides no datasets, baselines, or quantitative results.
watch_item: The optimization remains nonconvex, so convergence analysis should not be interpreted as a guarantee of global optimality.
paper_title: Infinity-Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Principal Component Analysis: Exact Reformulation, Finite-Sample Guarantee, and Efficient Algorithm
